context: Restrained trust-split redesign (Bybit/Stripe style) for Dynopay auth pages (/auth/login and /auth/register). Replaces the previous animated marketing reel (carousel, wallet count-up, coin marquee) with a calm, pure typographic + trust signals panel.
design_archetype: Restrained Trust Split (Swiss & High-Contrast / Tactical Minimalism)

layout_and_spacing.responsive_rule: The panel is strictly hidden on mobile/tablet (xs/sm/md) and rendered only at lg+ breakpoints. The form column handles mobile trust presentation separately via MobileTrustStrip.

section_1_eyebrow.name: Non-Custodial Security Pill
elements: Static gold indicator dot (7px diameter, NO pulsing animation)

section_2_hero_typography.headline: Institutional-grade crypto payments with zero custodial risk.
section_2_hero_typography.subheadline: Accept payments across 9 blockchains directly into your sovereign wallet. No balance locks, no intermediaries, transparent 0.5% settlement fees.

allowed_motion.entrance: authRise 560ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 120ms both (Single entrance reveal on component mount)
prohibited: NO counting up numbers or animated balances
NO pulsing glow dots or infinite keyframe loops
allowed_motion.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce by setting animation: 'none'

instructions_to_main_agent: Remove all state/effects/intervals related to carousel scenes, balance count-up, flow dots, and animated coin marquee.
Replace the panel content with a purely static, calm typographic layout and 2x2 trust signals grid as outlined in the blueprint.
Ensure all copy uses i18n t() keys from the 'auth' namespace with explicit defaultValues.
Maintain root data-testid="auth-brand-panel" and assign data-testids to grid cards.
Apply exact color rules for light and dark modes according to the existing brand palette.
Keep single entrance animation (authRise) and respect prefers-reduced-motion.

selected_state_system._source: UX layout audit 2026-10-08 S22 / blueprint §8.10 — exactly THREE selected looks, never mixed on one control type.

tabs_and_filter_chips.use_for: page tabs (OverflowTabs), status/segment chips (customers segments, notifications), filter-sheet options (FilterOptionChip), view toggles (products grid/list)
tabs_and_filter_chips.a11y: role=tab + aria-selected, or role=option + aria-selected inside a listbox

segmented_control.use_for: time-range presets (Today · 7D · 30D · 90D · 1Y · Custom), chart metric switch (Volume · Payments · Avg ticket)
segmented_control.look: track = muted surface pill; selected segment = solid brand yellow #FFD100 with #0A0A0B text (BRAND_ACCENT / BRAND_ON_ACCENT); same in light and dark
segmented_control.rule: yellow fill is reserved for the ONE active segment and primary CTAs — never for tabs or nav

navigation.use_for: sidebar rows, labelled rail, phone tab bar, More sheet rows
navigation.sidebar_row: gold text/icon (theme.palette.primary.main) + 3px gold left bar + rgba(255,209,0,0.12) tint; weight 600
navigation.rail_and_tab_bar: 52×28 pill behind the icon — light rgba(255,209,0,0.32), dark rgba(255,209,0,0.18); label weight 700 + text.primary

never: a gold/yellow pill for a list tab
a dark pill for the active nav row

shell_dark_mode._source: UX layout audit S23 — warm-black palette for every shell surface (no blue-grey).
shell_dark_mode.tokens: constants/theme.ts DARK.{canvas #131312, surface #1A1A19, raised #222221, active #2A2A28, border #2B2B29}
shell_dark_mode.phone_tab_bar: background DARK.surface, top hairline rgba(255,255,255,0.08), create (+) ring = DARK.surface
shell_dark_mode.bottom_sheets_and_more_sheet: paper = DARK.surface, drag handle rgba(255,255,255,0.22), row dividers rgba(255,255,255,0.06)
shell_dark_mode.sidebar_and_rail: background.paper of sidebarTheme (warm black); hover rgba(255,255,255,0.07)
shell_dark_mode.avatar: same filled-circle treatment in light and dark (no outline swap)

how: styles/tapTarget.ts tapY(h)/tapXY(size) — grow the element's own box, cancel with negative margin (layout-neutral)
data-touch-44 / data-touch-44="square" attribute → min 44px on (pointer: coarse) (globals.css)
data-tap-inline on links inside running text
every single-line MUI field is 44px tall on touch (globals.css)
